entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Several of my suppliers have stated that[n]they're going to stop selling to me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: If I can't get my hands on medical [n]supplies, I won't be able to get what [n]I need to complete the new medicine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: They're probably being pressured[n]by Oyamada to stop doing business[n]with me. So I figure it's over.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I confirmed with the hospital[n]Miwa-chan was being treated at...[n]Oyamada was telling the truth.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Miwa-chan was apparently smiling until[n]the very end. She probably didn't[n]want to worry anyone.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I wish I could've cured her...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I didn't want fame or money. All I[n]wanted... was to keep her smiling...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: This isn't just about her though...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was going to help every single person[n]who was suffering from that disease...!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was a sickly child when I was[n]young too...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was always in the hospital... and was[n]rarely well enough to attend school at all.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Medicine was all that kept me alive...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That's why I wanted to become a doctor...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So I could save people, just like[n]I was saved...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...But I guess this is where it ends...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The medical industry is a business,[n]after all, and the chief decides what's[n]best for it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What am I supposed to do...?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You might just be my one and only...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: My practice increased thanks to your[n]nosiness, and in the end, I felt like[n]a real doctor again.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I can't do clinical trials anymore,[n]so you can go home.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Thanks again for all your help.[n]And good luck on those entrance exams.
Is there anything I can do for Takemi...?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You mean Oyamada? Why? I hope you're[n]not planning to get revenge for me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: His full name is [clr 2]Shoichi Oyamada[clr 27]. [n]He's a very influential Chief of[n]Staff in the world of medicine...
I need to do something about[n]the target for Takemi...
